title.zh: 证明方法、归纳法与不变式

lead.en: Write arguments that cover every allowed case. Learn direct and indirect proofs, induction over numbers and structures, and separate proofs that a program returns the right result and eventually stops.
lead.zh: 写出覆盖所有允许情况的论证。学习直接与间接证明、数与结构归纳，并分别证明程序结果正确和最终终止。

prerequisites.en: Modules 02–03: quantified statements, counterexamples, membership proofs, relations, and function contracts. Retrieve the implication–contrapositive equivalence and the definitions of equality and subset.
prerequisites.zh: 模块 02–03：量化陈述、反例、成员证明、关系与函数约定。回忆蕴含与逆否等价，以及相等和子集定义。

en: State hypotheses and conclusions and select a valid proof method.
Write direct, contrapositive, contradiction, existence, and uniqueness arguments.
Prove statements by weak or strong induction with explicit base cases.
Use recursive definitions and structural induction without assuming the result.
Prove search partial correctness with an invariant and termination with a decreasing natural-number measure.
zh: 明确假设与结论并选择有效证明方法。
写直接、逆否、反证、存在与唯一性论证。
带明确基础情况完成普通或强归纳。
利用递归定义与结构归纳，避免预先假定结果。
用不变式证明搜索的部分正确性，用递减自然数度量证明终止。

text.en: Read Sections 1–2 and reconstruct the direct and indirect proofs.
text.zh: 阅读第 1–2 节，重建直接与间接证明。

text.en: Run Lab 1 and distinguish checked evidence from proof.
text.zh: 运行实验 1，区分检验证据与证明。

text.en: Retrieve assumptions, arbitrary inputs, and counterexample obligations.
text.zh: 回忆假设、任意输入与反例义务。

text.en: Read Sections 3–4 and write the induction argument yourself.
text.zh: 阅读第 3–4 节，自己写归纳论证。

text.en: Read the proof-method and induction selections.
text.zh: 阅读证明方法与归纳选段。

text.en: Name the base, hypothesis, and step without looking.
text.zh: 不看材料说明基础、假设与归纳步。

text.en: Read Section 5 and trace the recursive construction.
text.zh: 阅读第 5 节并跟踪递归构造。

text.en: Run Lab 3; repair the missing base and missing decrease.
text.zh: 运行实验 3，修复缺基础与不递减。

text.en: Read structural induction and compare its constructor cases.
text.zh: 阅读结构归纳并比较构造情况。

text.en: Read Section 6 and operate the invariant trace.
text.zh: 阅读第 6 节并操作不变式跟踪。

text.en: Instrument the search and explain each invariant/variant check.
text.zh: 为搜索加检查并解释不变式与变式。

text.en: Complete nine choices and the written correctness argument.
text.zh: 完成九道选择与书面正确性论证。

text.en: Read the invariant selection and identify its program point.
text.zh: 阅读不变式选段并指出程序观察点。

text.en: Complete the reasoning checkpoint and next-module readiness task.
text.zh: 完成推理检查点与下一模块准备任务。
